newsitem.title: GERMANY: BUBA ALLOTS 79.8 BLN MARKS IN REPO, ADDS FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: BUBA ALLOTS 79.8 BLN MARKS IN REPO, ADDS FUNDS.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 79.8 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a three percent fixed rate.
The central bank said it accepted 28.00 percent of the total bids made.
A repo pact for 79.4 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires Wednesday, so a net 400 million marks is flowing into the market.
Money market traders had been predicting a net addition of up to three billion marks of funds in this week's tender to offset a shortage of liquidity.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 285.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since August 1996.
